callout.label: Callout
callout.description: A boxed note, tip, warning, or danger message that stands out from the text around it.
callout.placeholder: Callouts hold ordinary text, so they can carry **bold** words, lists, and `code` like the rest of the page.

tone.label: Kind
tone.description: Sets the icon, the colour, and the heading readers see.

title.label: Heading
title.description: Replaces the heading. Leave empty to show the kind, such as Note or Warning.

tabs.label: Tabs
tabs.description: Alternatives side by side, such as the same steps for macOS, Windows, and Linux. Readers pick one tab at a time.
tabs.placeholder:
:::tab{label="macOS"}
Install it with Homebrew:

```sh
brew install example
```
:::

:::tab{label="Windows"}
Install it with winget:

```sh
winget install example
```
:::

:::tab{label="Linux"}
Install it with your package manager:

```sh
sudo apt install example
```
:::

tab.label: Tab
tab.description: One tab inside Tabs. On its own it shows as a single labelled panel.
tab.placeholder: What readers who pick this tab need to know.

label.label: Tab name
label.description: The name on the tab, such as macOS or npm.

site-header.label: Header
site-header.description: The bar across the top of every page, with the site name, the menu, and the light and dark switch.

site-name.label: Site name
site-name.description: The site's name in the header, linking to the home page.

nav.label: Navigation
nav.description: The menu links in the header.

sidebar.label: Docs sidebar
sidebar.description: The numbered contents beside docs pages. On phones, the Contents button above the page and the list it opens.

main.label: Main area
main.description: The page between the header and the footer. On docs pages it sits beside the sidebar.

page-header.label: Page title
page-header.description: The block above the text of every page: the title, the description, and on docs pages the page number and section.

content.label: Page content
content.description: The rendered markdown of every page, and nothing the theme draws around it.

chapter-number.label: Page numbers
chapter-number.description: Numbers such as 2 and 2.1: in the sidebar, above a docs page's title, and on the previous and next links.

callout.label: Callouts
callout.description: Note, tip, warning, and danger boxes. Each also carries data-tone with its kind.

tabs.label: Tabs
tabs.description: A tabs block: its row of tabs and the panels below. A tab on its own is marked the same way.

page-nav.label: Previous and next links
page-nav.description: The links at the end of a docs page to the pages before and after it.

site-footer.label: Footer
site-footer.description: The line across the bottom of every page.

accentColor.label: Accent colour
accentColor.description: Links, the current page in the sidebar, page numbers, focus outlines, and buttons.

textColor.label: Text colour
textColor.description: Body text. Lines, quieter text, and code backgrounds are mixed from this and the background colour.

backgroundColor.label: Background colour
backgroundColor.description: The page behind everything. Keep it far from the text colour so the text stays easy to read.

textFont.label: Text font
textFont.description: Open Sans comes with the theme. The others use fonts already on the reader's device, so they load instantly but vary a little between devices.

options.label: System, the device's own font
options.css: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

options.label: Humanist sans, such as Seravek or Calibri
options.css: Seravek, "Gill Sans Nova", Ubuntu, Calibri, "DejaVu Sans", sans-serif

options.label: Serif, such as Charter or Cambria

codeFont.label: Code font
codeFont.description: Used for code and page numbers. Source Code Pro comes with the theme.

options.label: Source Code Pro
options.css: "Source Code Pro", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

options.label: System, the device's own code font
options.css: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", "Cascadia Code", Menlo, Consolas, "DejaVu Sans Mono", monospace

corners.label: Corners
corners.description: How rounded buttons, code blocks, tables, and boxes are.

pageWidth.label: Page width
pageWidth.description: How far the header, footer, and docs area stretch on large screens.

sidebarWidth.label: Sidebar width
sidebarWidth.description: How much room the docs contents get on large screens. Wider suits long page titles.

readingWidth.label: Reading width
readingWidth.description: The longest a line of text can get. Narrower is easier to read; wider fits big tables and code.

sidebarSide.label: Sidebar side
sidebarSide.description: Where the docs contents sit on large screens. On phones they always open from a button above the page.

chapterNumbers.label: Number the pages
chapterNumbers.description: Show numbers such as 2 and 2.1 beside each docs page in the sidebar, above its title, and on the previous and next links.

pageLinks.label: Previous and next links
pageLinks.description: Show links at the end of each docs page to the pages before and after it.
